source.scope_note: Historical 2014-oriented source plus a 2023-08-05 gamefiles snapshot. Metadata inventory only; no claim of current live Metin2 completeness.

enumeration_method.ordering: All filesystem and token arrays are lexicographically sorted unless source order is semantically relevant (commands, enum members, locale_list).
enumeration_method.source_units: Recursive tracked-checkout walk filtered to .c/.cc/.cpp/.h/.hpp under the declared roots; names only.
enumeration_method.commands: Parse command_info initializer rows in src/game/src/cmd.cpp; preserve source order and identify the enclosing __AUCTION__ preprocessor branch.
enumeration_method.quest_apis: Parse luaL_reg arrays associated with AddLuaFunctionTable plus the global registration array; preserve function source order.
enumeration_method.switches: Lexically enumerate named preprocessor switch occurrences across src/game/src, src/db/src and src/common, then inspect active #define sites.
enumeration_method.packet_enums: Lexically enumerate HEADER_*/QID_* tokens and enum/member names from the declared shared headers; do not evaluate numeric expressions or struct layouts.
enumeration_method.content: Sorted recursive directory walks plus exact locale_list membership; file sizes and line counts come from the pinned checkout.
enumeration_method.feature_mapping: Commands, quests and general catalogs use best-effort keyword routing to SRV IDs for triage. Maps use the separately declared filename-family routing below and default to SRV-005. Source responsibility groups are hand-reviewed basename groupings with mechanical completeness checks. Names/paths are authoritative; mappings still require profile/reachability review.

This maps source units to planning responsibilities. It does not prove code reachability, runtime enablement, correctness, or release-profile inclusion.

parse_limitations: Line-oriented initializer parser; commented-out command rows may be included if they retain initializer syntax.
Runtime privilege overrides from gamefiles/conf/CMD are separately catalogued.
Only luaL_reg arrays associated with AddLuaFunctionTable or the global registration array are enumerated.
Lua helper functions from questlib.lua/GFquestlib.lua are content libraries and are not native API bindings.

maps.feature_mapping_method: Case-folded directory-name family routing: wedding→SRV-035; guild land/siege→SRV-025; battle/duel/PvP arena→SRV-027; Three-Way/empire war/Sungzi→SRV-048; named event maps→SRV-049; Devil/catacomb/spider→SRV-031; dragon/Skipia→SRV-032; flame and named 90+ regions→SRV-033; monkey/field dungeons→SRV-030; all other map directories→SRV-005. This is a planning category, not proof of quest linkage or profile activation.

monsters.note: Directories contain server motion metadata, not authoritative mob_proto rows.

missing_or_unparsed: No SQL schema/migrations are present in this repository; SQL table contracts were inferred from query strings and packet structs, not validated against a database dump.
No client tree was joined into this server-only ledger; cross-side packet compatibility requires the separate client audit.
No source or gamefile was executed, compiled, or loaded into a legacy runtime.
The archive has no license file; source inspection does not establish redistribution rights.
The source README explicitly warns that many public exploits remain unpatched.

locale_list is a deployment selection, while 284 .quest sources exist; inactive, test, xxx-prefixed, backup, and generated artifacts are retained in the catalog but are not baseline gameplay promises.

The selected horse quest set omits pony_buy.quest and pony_levelup.quest even though later horse progression quests are selected; this snapshot alone does not prove a complete initial horse-acquisition chain.
change_name.quest is selected but declares the internal quest name chagne_name; source inspection did not execute it, so name-change runtime parity remains unverified.
Item enum/type presence is not treated as reachability: several types and use subtypes reach empty or rejecting direct-use branches and may depend on another packet, quest, or no active content.
The empty drop_item_group.txt and absence of database seed/schema files make several content domains incomplete as a standalone runnable server.
